title: Lattices: meets, joins, bounds, and distributivity
fact_or_context_to_reference: Binary infima and suprema imply associativity, commutativity, idempotence, and absorption. Distinguish bounded, distributive, complemented, and complete lattices; the Boolean arguments use finite lattice operations. Power-set lattices have unions and intersections as joins and meets, including empty bounds; order isomorphisms preserve bounds.
